messages:
lee: deploy-bot just tripped: post-canary latency and a small spike in 502s for release v4.0.0. Change window still open. We have Dedicated customers on some routes. Thoughts on auto vs manual?

deploy-bot: Policy: p95 > 600ms for 3m on canary. Suggested action: autorevert to 3.9.7. Note: autorevert will affect all slices including Dedicated unless pinned.

anya: We shouldn't blast Dedicated. Recommend human safety-latch: suppress autorevert and run a partial rollback on the canary only, then pin critical routes.

ops-bot: @lee safety-latch applied: suppressing auto-rollback for 15 minutes. Operator hold id: hold-4765-1.

samir: Quick telemetry: a cluster of requests hit a quant->fp16 fallback path and kernel selector flipped. Latency spike correlates with those events.

lee: Plan proposal: 1) rollback only the canary slice to 3.9.7; 2) pin Dedicated and high-traffic A/B buckets to 3.9.7; 3) notify CS + Legal for any customer-facing wording; 4) update release notes to mark v4.0.0 as paused.

anya: I'll run the rollback and route pins. Commands:
```
# partial rollback
redwoodctl rollout rollback --service=inference --to-version=3.9.7 --slice=canary --reason="post-canary tail latency"
# pin two critical routes
redwoodctl routes pin --route=dedicated-eu --version=3.9.7 --note="safety-latch-pin"
redwoodctl routes pin --route=ab-test-bucket1 --version=3.9.7 --note="protect-heavy-bucket"
```

legal: CC: brief us on the customer impact blurb. We'll review for external comms. Keep it factual and short.

samir: Snippet from runtime logs:
```
[2026-07-12T11:02:19Z] runtime: kvcache miss -> quant fallback -> kernel=selector_v2 -> latency 680ms
[2026-07-12T11:02:20Z] frontend: upstream 10.6.3.21:502
```

anya: Initiating canary rollback now.

ops-bot: ACTION: rollback started by anya at 2026-07-12T11:04:05Z. job=rb-4765432101-a

anya: Canary rollback finished. Running smoke tests and short traffic validation.

anya: Smoke: p95 on canary back to baseline (~130ms), 502s cleared on canary hosts. Pin applied to dedicated-eu and ab-test-bucket1.

lee: Draft for CS + Legal: 
"During a canary rollout for release v4.0.0 we observed increased tail latency for a small subset of traffic. We have rolled the canary back to the previous stable release and pinned high-risk customer routes as a precaution. No action is required from customers; we will follow up with a full post-mortem and timeline for a safe re-release."

legal: Reviewed, minor wording tweak suggested. Approved to send.

samir: Next steps: eng to triage kernel selector change, reproduce locally, and prepare a hotfix candidate. Opening PM ticket PM-4022 and attaching logs + rollback commands.

deploy-bot: Manual rollback and pins recorded. Recommendation: block selector_v2 from candidate builds until validated in CI.

lee: We'll leave canary pinned for 1h then release back to deploy-bot scheduling if all clear. Marking v4.0.0 as paused in release notes now. If anything regresses, reopen this thread or ping @ops. :white_check_mark:
